title: Season 1
synopsis: Natsuki Subaru is suddenly summoned to an alternate fantasy world, discovering that whenever he dies, time reverses back to a 'save point'.

title: Season 1 (Director's Cut)
synopsis: A re-edited 13-episode broadcast of Season 1 with updated animation cuts, audio adjustments, and the crucial cliffhanger ending leading into Season 2.

title: Season 2
synopsis: Subaru faces the Witch of Greed and the deadly trials of the Sanctuary to save Emilia and the villagers of Arlam.

title: Season 3
synopsis: One year after the Sanctuary, the Royal Selection camps gather at the water city of Priestella, which is besieged by the Sin Archbishops.

title: Season 4
synopsis: Subaru and his companions venture into the Pleiades Watchtower across the Augria Sand Dunes to find a cure for the victims of Priestella.
